verdict.rationale: Marqeta's Core API exposes transaction retrieval by card/merchant/account holder and sandbox simulation of authorizations/reversals/balance inquiries, which is a building block for a ledger, but there is no evidence of a finance-facing balance/ledger view, authorization-to-clearing tying, or penny-accurate settlement reconciliation reporting. missing for 10: settlement reporting/reconciliation documentation, explicit authorization-to-clearing ledger linkage, real-time balance reporting for finance users, independent corroboration of reconciliation accuracy.
